method: Production Vite build, controls only from runway launch, native browser wall clock and production fixed-step Time. Most catalog checks use a 100 ms draw interval; the two Free flights use full draw cadence. Every mission exercises boost and actual gate top-ups; both Free flights drain to empty, passively refill to 75% and boost again. Streaming, weather, collision, gates, scoring and record identity are active. Optional contract bonus and medal optimization are not acceptance requirements.
limits: This is playability/physics compatibility evidence. It does not certify every seed, hardware device, performance target or optional contract goal. Interrupted flights are rerun and do not count.
